single.rationale: Bio-Techne faces severe profitability deterioration with operating margin collapsing from 27% (FY2023) to 8.4% (FY2025) and net income down 76% over two years, driven by a non-recurring arbitration loss, asset impairments, and restructuring charges. While the company maintains strong gross margins (65%), diversified customer base, and solid FCF generation ($257M), the combination of minimal revenue growth (5% organic), elevated valuation (116x P/E, 33x P/FCF), and ongoing margin pressure warrants monitoring before deeper engagement.
